title: Story vs Telling Part 3
summary: Kahran workshops Divya through the third installment of their story-vs-telling thread — how to introduce yourself authentically when your identity is genuinely multi-disciplinary (game-maker, VFX artist, design studio co-founder, social media artist). They land on tailoring the telling to who's in the room while not forcing a single tidy summary, with detours into ice stupas, deserts, and Fran Dunaway's career switches.
topics: telling your story to different audiences

intents.display: to workshop introducing yourself when your work spans many disciplines
